creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-10-26 on 0.19.0 with Claude Code 2.1.310, closing panes that ran `extras/claude-code/messaging-hooks.json`. After `muster pane close`, the pane left `muster window`, but its shell, launcher and `claude` processes stayed in state `?E` (exiting). The Stop hook's `/bin/sh -c muster msg wait --due ...` and its `muster msg wait --due` child, which carries the closed pane's `MUSTER_PANE`, kept running. Claude Code cannot finish exiting while an async hook runs, and the hook's timeout is 86400 s, so each closed pane can hold a dead session and a daemon connection for up to a day. Killing the `muster msg wait` child let all of them exit at once.

Possibly: have `muster msg wait` end when its pane closes, since the daemon knows, or have pane close end the pane's waits. Failing that, a shorter hook timeout re-armed each turn.
title: A closed pane's Claude Code stays exiting for up to a day while its Stop hook's msg wait runs
